title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person awaiting UPDATE executed by the handler still lacks the taken_over_at IS NULL backstop — mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is dead code and the race pin is vacuous
evidence:
form_handler.gleam apply_wrong_person False arm:
              case
                sql.update_reference_call_status(
                  config.db,
                  id_uuid,
                  sql.AwaitingCorrection,
                  "",
                  "contact_invalid",
                  sql.ContactInitiated,
                )
update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24:
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status
mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql (guarded, never called from server/src):
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = 'contact_initiated'::reference_call_status
  AND taken_over_at IS NULL
reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1746:
    rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)
detail: The executed wrong-person UPDATE has no taken_over_at guard (WHERE id+status only); the dedicated guarded SQL is called only by the test, and no test drives handle_wrong_person_post on a taken-over row — neutralizing the backstop turns nothing red. The race stays open: take-over commits between the token read and the UPDATE (status stays contact_initiated), the UPDATE matches, and the landlord-handled row dead-ends in awaiting_correction.
recommended_fix: Wire apply_wrong_person's False arm to mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person (0 rows → redirect); replace the direct-SQL pin with a POST-route test that takes the row over after the read and asserts it stays contact_initiated.

title: kind-tag co-nudge exclusion is data-dependent — untagged pre-migration co-nudge entries in append-only attempts logs still match find_reference_call_by_send_ref
evidence:
find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql:85 (PRIMARY EXISTS; same at 47, 63):
        AND NOT (e ? 'kind')
The tag is written only by the NEW sweep code (sweep.gleam:820):
    #("kind", json.string("co_nudge")),
Legacy entries (old sweep, no kind) never get re-tagged: attempts is append-only.
detail: A bounce of the applicant's co-nudge address whose send_ref matches a legacy untagged entry still matches: pre-correction rows get a fabricated awaiting_correction; a post-correction co-nudge (restarted cadence, interim-deploy window) yields send_is_post_correction true → fabricated exhaustion + referee_contact_invalid.
recommended_fix: Backfill the kind tag via migration or exclude legacy co-nudge entries by matching only entries without a 'reason' key plus a correction-relative timestamp check; at minimum document the residual window.

title: genuine post-correction failure on the fallback leg is dropped — the SQL gates both fallback branches on correction_cycles = 0, contradicting the handler's 'treated as genuine' comment
detail: For correction_cycles >= 1 rows the contact fallback cannot match (SQL gate), so a genuine post-correction failure whose delivered entry is missing (crash-mid-tick) finds 0 rows and stands down: no exhaustion, no referee_contact_invalid stamp, no landlord notification — the row re-sends to the failing address until the silent T+144h sweep terminal.
recommended_fix: Align the handler comment with the pre-correction-only fallback, or re-enable the fallback for corrected rows keyed on the corrected channel + corrected_at guard; the current drift misleads the exhaustion-gate reader.
